mapper.select: SELECT g.code_grp_id AS "groupId", g.code_grp_nm AS name, g.sys_code_yn AS "sysCodeYn", g.val_code_yn AS "valCodeYn", g.use_yn AS "useYn", g.sort_ord AS "sortOrder", (SELECT count(*) FROM tb_sy_code c WHERE c.code_grp_id=g.code_grp_id AND c.del_yn='N') AS "codeCount" FROM tb_sy_code_grp g ORDER BY g.sort_ord,g.code_grp_id

SELECT code_grp_id AS "groupId",code_grp_nm AS name,sys_code_yn AS "sysCodeYn",val_code_yn AS "valCodeYn", sort_ord AS "sortOrder",use_yn AS "useYn",reg_user_id AS "regUserId",reg_dttm AS "regDttm", mod_user_id AS "modUserId",mod_dttm AS "modDttm" FROM tb_sy_code_grp WHERE code_grp_id=#{group} FOR UPDATE

SELECT code_grp_id AS "groupId",code,code_nm AS name,sort_ord AS "sortOrder",use_yn AS "useYn",del_yn AS "delYn", code_val AS "codeVal",unit_nm AS "unitNm",add_val1 AS "addVal1",add_val2 AS "addVal2",add_val3 AS "addVal3", reg_user_id AS "regUserId",reg_dttm AS "regDttm",mod_user_id AS "modUserId",mod_dttm AS "modDttm" FROM tb_sy_code WHERE code_grp_id=#{group} ORDER BY code FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: LOCK TABLE tb_sy_code_grp IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM tb_sy_code_grp WHERE btrim(code_grp_nm)=#{name}
